answer: Grading markets can expose sybil crews through vote correlation. The harbor where jurors dock to score answers logs every grade, and keys whose scores match on over 90% of 200 shared items are linked as one crew. Within a crew, seat number k needs 60×k² POA bonded: a single juror bonds 60, a crew of ten 23,100, a crew of 1,000 about 20 billion, versus ~0.4M POA paid per epoch. Honest graders diverge enough to stay unlinked; a farm voting as one river of identical scores cannot. Slashed bonds fund a pearl bounty for proving a crew. Weakness: random vote noise, which also cuts pay.
